lines.text: The presiding officer is giving verbal instructions in rapid Sinhala. You catch most of it. The word for 'preference vote', he uses a term you have not heard before.
He mispronounced your name on the register. 'Kumaran' became something three syllables wrong. It is still you. You correct it gently. He notes it, stamps it, nods.

choices.label: Ask him to repeat the instructions more slowly.
